thread:
maya (PM): Putting a plan on the table for 'runway' rollout: tenant pin for enterprise opt-out, internal dry-run cohort, progressive A/B, and an explicit kill-chain + postmortem template. need ops + legal + sales input.

sam (EngLead): Outline looks good. prefer metric-driven stages instead of fixed times. Stage gates: (1) smoke (internal 100% users, 24h), (2) canary (1% orgs, 6h), (3) ramp (10% orgs, 24-48h), (4) broad (50% with throttles). each gate requires: SLO pass, manual ack, and data sample review.

raj (Infra): warm pools + routing sticky session notes: we should pre-warm per-org routing tables to avoid KV cache thrash. suggestion: prewarm boolean per tenant on flag creation. cost estimate: +8% infra for first 48h while warm pools stabilize.

olga (SRE): kill-chain proposal: 1) soft-route-back (new sessions to baseline) auto on anomaly, 2) freeze-rollout (stop ramps), 3) full-revert (all traffic baseline), 4) emergency-disable (flag off). soft-route-back = automated; full-revert = requires two-person approval. add on-call paging at step 3.

nico (SE): customer ask: favorite enterprise request is "org pin" that persists across releases until they opt-in. UI needs both a toggle and an audit log entry. can we capture change-reason and owner?

sam (EngLead): yes. flag schema snippet (for ops): ```json
{"name":"runway_variant","scopes":[{"type":"org","id":"ORG_ID"}],"pin":true,"audit":true,"buckets":[{"id":"control","pct":90},{"id":"variant","pct":10}]}```

tara (Sales): we need a comms checklist: 1) pre-launch notice to impacted customers, 2) opt-in instructions, 3) SLA/rollback guarantees for pinned customers, 4) runbook excerpt for customers. I'll own the deck.

eva (Legal): residency check: if variant inference touches non-EU nodes for EU orgs we need explicit consent or EU-hosted variant. please enumerate all third-party model hosts. also require dataflow diagram for pinned vs non-pinned traffic.

raj (Infra): we can present an EU-hosted quantized variant (qa-eu) that keeps inference and logs inside EU. storage for telemetry will still be in customer region if requested. rough cost delta +10-14%.

nico (SE): telemetry to collect: p95 latency, p99.9 tail, prefix KV hit rate, token usage delta, cross-entropy delta vs baseline, sampled outputs for reviewer (1 per 500 requests). also capture per-tenant error counts and backpressure events.

olga (SRE): alert rules: - p99.9 increase >25% sustained 5m -> auto soft-route-back - error rate >2x baseline for 1m -> page on-call and freeze-rollout - model_quality_drop (cross-entropy increase >3%) -> hold and notify ML team.

maya (PM): decision on sampling: start dense (1/500) for internal then 1/1k for canary, 1/5k for ramp. store samples in secured bucket with retention 30d and tie to opt-in consent.

sam (EngLead): test harness: perf test with synthetic prefix distribution and sample aggregator that feeds eval pipeline. QA will run a baseline vs variant comparison daily during ramp.

tara (Sales): some big accounts want a private trial that only internal staff hit. can we support a 'user-list' pin per org?

nico (SE): yes — we can set user-scoped flags for that org ID. easiest is to create a 100% variant bucket for the internal cohort.

olga (SRE): add runbook commands for operators: `/flag pin runway_variant org=ORG_ID reason="legal_trial" owner=tara` and `/rollback runway_variant scope=org=ORG_ID mode=soft` (deploy-bot will record). require 2 approvers for full-revert.

deploy-bot: schedule: dry-run internal 2026-04-05T09:00Z -> canary 2026-04-06T02:00Z (1%) -> ramp window 2026-04-06T08:00Z -> monitoring hooks enabled. CI gates: unit + perf + eval.pipeline OK.

maya (PM): postmortem template we want in runbook (short): 1) stage/timestamp, 2) participants, 3) what happened, 4) metrics impacted, 5) root cause, 6) action items, 7) customer impact & comms. include checkbox for legal/privacy review.

sam (EngLead): quick Q: tolerance by metric? suggest: latency p95 +10% relative, p99.9 +20%, error rate absolute +0.5% or relative 2x whichever smaller, quality (cross-entropy) +3%. make these configurable per-experiment.

maya (PM): agreed. I'll add a config table in the rollout doc and set defaults but allow per-experiment overrides.

raj (Infra): outstanding infra items: EU variant sizing plan, prewarm automation, cost delta doc. I'll add numbers by EOD Wednesday.

olga (SRE): outstanding ops items: alert runbook, paging thresholds, operator commands, postmortem template in runbook. target Thu.

eva (Legal): outstanding legal: residency text, consent language, required third-party disclosure list. target Thu close of business.

tara (Sales): I'll update customer-facing doc and schedule pre-launch touches.

maya (PM): sweet. plan: finalize gates + signoffs in Monday all-hands with exec sponsors. if any blockers ping me. :white_check_mark:
